nodes.label: CI workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs on push to main, pull_request and workflow_dispatch. Concurrency group keyed on workflow and ref with cancel-in-progress so a push to a branch with an open PR runs once and a newer push replaces a running one. Permissions are contents: read only.

nodes.label: CI check job (typecheck, lint, test, build, cargo check)
nodes.rationale: Runs on macos-latest because the package's native dependencies (onnxruntime, the wake word and the voice) and the desktop app both build for it and it is the only platform the release ships for; Linux support would add a second runner, not replace this one. pnpm version comes from packageManager in package.json so there is one place to bump it. Runs pnpm exec nx run-many -t typecheck lint test build, then generates icons, then nx run desktop:cargo-check.

nodes.label: Tauri generate_context! ordering constraint
nodes.rationale: Tauri's generate_context! macro embeds the frontend and the app icon at compile time and panics when either is missing, so cargo check must come after the nx build (which writes apps/desktop/dist) and after icon generation from src-tauri/icon.png, which is not checked in.
